name: Tazuln
home: Hillside shelter north of Orziben; 11 holes in the roof
appearance: Age unclear. Milky, restless eyes. Small scars on his hands.
and_yet: Never loses anything. Knows who’s there before they speak.
sayings: That ledge is much lower in the fourth world.
wants: A student who won't flinch at what the other worlds look like.
dreams: To find a portal at one of the twenty vertices before he dies.
oddly_also: Always has a stew on. Breaks bread with unseen beings.
anecdotes: Described the interior of a sealed Ilmenor vault in Imazuran in precise detail. He has never been inside it. The Ilmenor have not commented.
Walked off a roof once. Got up, dusted off, said 'that ledge is much lower in the fourth world.' Has not elaborated.
tragedies: All his friends live in other worlds so he only gets to see them through a glass, darkly.
campaign_notes: Will teach Chekkad that illusions are not fabrications but resonance — light and form bleeding through from adjacent worlds.
